pages.title: Ritual Preparations: Sacrificial Bowls
pages.text: These bowls are used to place the items we will sacrifice as part of a ritual and you will need a handful of them.$(br)Note: Their exact placement in the ritual does not matter - just keep them within 8 blocks horizontally of the pentacle $()
You can mix a sacrificial bowl with a copper or silver ingot to create variations with the same functionality.$(br)

pages.title: Bowls and Spirit Fire
pages.text: If you place a sacrificial bowl above a Spirit Fire or Spirit Campfire,$(br)any item inserted will instantly transform if it has a recipe in the spirit fire.$(br)Also work with copper or silver version of sacrificial bowl.$(br)

Once everything has been set up and you are ready to start, this special ritual bowl is used to activate the ritual by $(#ad03fc)right-clicking$() it with the activation item,$(br)usually a $(l:getting_started/books_of_binding)Book of Binding$(/l).$(br)
